## Summary: Laurent About Us Page Clone

### Key Decisions Made

**1. Componentization Strategy:**
- **Header/Navigation**: Fixed position header with logo and nav menu items
- **Hero Section**: Full-width dark overlay with centered title and decorative SVG elements
- **Main Content**: Three-column grid layout (SVG pattern | text content | image)
- **Video Section**: Background image with centered play button
- **Testimonials**: Owl Carousel slider with navigation dots
- **Footer**: Centered content with restaurant info and social links

**2. Design Token Implementation:**
From windtailor analysis, implemented key colors:
- Primary accent: `#9c7c57` (tan/gold)
- Light accent: `#c9ab81` (lighter gold)
- Foreground text: `#afb8b8` (light gray)
- Background: `#0c1315` (dark navy)
- Secondary: `#715b3e` (brown)

**3. Special Handling:**
- **Fonts**: Loaded Google Fonts (Mrs Saint Delafield for headings, Open Sans for body)
- **SVG Elements**: Reproduced decorative dividers and geometric patterns inline
- **External Libraries**: CDN-loaded Owl Carousel for testimonial slider, Font Awesome for potential icons
- **Images**: Hotlinked to original website (absolute URLs preserved)
- **Responsive**: Basic media query for tablets/mobile breakpoint at 1024px

**4. Self-Contained HTML:**
- All CSS inlined in `<style>` tags
- All HTML elements directly in the markup
- External dependencies from trusted CDNs (Google Fonts, cdnjs)
- No build process required—opens directly in any browser

### Fidelity Comparison

**Full-page pixel diff**: 23.15% difference (77% match)
- Main differences due to: font rendering, image load timing, minor spacing nuances
- Structure, layout, colors, and typography match very closely
- Both main sections (hero title and content) verified visually similar

### What Works Well
✓ Header navigation with proper styling  
✓ Hero title section with background image  
✓ Three-column main content with proper alignment  
✓ SVG decorative patterns  
✓ Testimonial carousel functionality (Owl Carousel)  
✓ Footer with contact info and social links  
✓ Dark luxury aesthetic preserved  
✓ Typography and color scheme accurate  

### File Location
**Output**: `/var/folders/gb/m6478s0n5mx9wqlz8t_c03800000gn/T/gumshoe-agent-run-dXr4kE/clone.html`

The HTML file is production-ready, self-contained, and requires only a modern web browser to display. All assets are either inline (styles, SVG) or sourced from reliable CDNs.
